title: The GONG — Latest feed
description: The published feed the site's Latest tab consumes. Emitted by the scheduled build pipeline.

generated_at.description: When this feed file was built.

id.description: Stable dedupe key, 'source:documentId'. Never changes for a given document.

date.description: Event / publication date (YYYY-MM-DD), used for chronological ordering.

type.description: Top-level category — drives the coloured badge. Closed enum.

entity.description: Issuer, regulator or index provider the item concerns.

stock_code.description: HKEX stock code when the item concerns a listed/applying company.

url.description: Canonical link to the primary document.

tags.description: Controlled-vocabulary tags only (see taxonomy.json). No free-form values.

summary.description: Our own neutral 1-2 sentence summary. Never the copyrighted source text.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence for type/tags; low values can be flagged for review.
